evidence.claim: Westrock Coffee describes itself as an integrated coffee, tea, flavors, extracts, and ingredients solutions provider serving retail, foodservice, and restaurant customers.

Westrock's investor relations overview says it provides coffee sourcing, supply chain management, product development, roasting, packaging, and distribution services to retail, foodservice, and restaurant industries.
Farmer Brothers describes itself as a coffee company and distributor of coffee, tea, and other beverage and culinary goods, with a direct store delivery network.
Farmer Brothers says it is a leading coffee roaster, wholesaler, equipment servicer, and distributor serving operators including restaurants, hotels, and foodservice distributors.
Middleby's beverage brand pages show coffee and beverage systems including Bloomfield, JoeTap, Concordia, and Wunder-Bar, with applications spanning coffee, nitro, tea, and beverage dispensing.

Middleby says JoeTap delivers still or nitro coffee, flavored teas, lemonades, and juice from keg or bag-in-box, while Bloomfield is a commercial coffee brewing equipment brand and Concordia is a bean-to-cup coffee and espresso system.

memory_update.text: WEST is the cleanest US-listed pure play for integrated coffee, tea, extract, and private-label beverage solutions in restaurants and foodservice.
FARM is a small/micro-cap, low-attention direct foodservice coffee distributor and equipment servicer worth watching as an underfollowed node name.
The public universe for this node is thin; the best second-order exposure often hides in equipment, dispensing systems, and broad foodservice distributors rather than obvious consumer coffee brands.

node: B2B coffee, tea, extracts, and private-label beverage solutions
summary: Cleanest public pure play in this node is WEST. The most underfollowed direct operating name is FARM. A useful second-order beneficiary is MIDD via commercial coffee and beverage equipment. SYY is included only as a downstream distribution anchor to validate beverage pull through broad foodservice channels.
